title: collectReward Call Does Not Verify Token Transfer
description: After the claimer sends payment, collectReward(actualPayment) is called on Phlimbo but there is no verification that tokens were actually received by Phlimbo. The function assumes the transfer succeeded without checking.
impact: Reward tokens could get stuck in the accumulator contract and not be distributed to stakers. If Phlimbo's collectReward() fails silently or doesn't properly account for received tokens, stakers lose their expected rewards.
attackPath: Claimer initiates claim() with valid parameters
Payment is transferred from claimer to accumulator
Phlimbo fails to properly receive or account for tokens
Tokens remain stuck in accumulator, stakers receive nothing
recommendation: Add balance checks before and after the collectReward() call to verify Phlimbo received the expected amount. Consider adding a return value check if collectReward() returns success status.
